name: Trastuzumab (Herceptin)
clinical_indication: HER2-overexpressing metastatic breast cancer and metastatic gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma.
mechanism: Recombinant humanized monoclonal antibody targeting extracellular domain IV of the HER2 receptor, preventing receptor dimerization, suppressing shedding, and inducing antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity (ADCC).
